purpose: Approved source catalog for selecting IELTS practice without inventing tests or answer keys.

rules: Use the exact materialUrl attached to an IELTS Journey task whenever one is present.
For ordinary Listening or Reading practice without a fixed material, prefer a teacher-recommended provider from this catalog.
The owner opens and completes a concrete test on the provider platform; Joy does not scrape or reproduce the full test.
Treat the provider result and answer check as practice evidence, not as an official IELTS score.
Use official IELTS materials for baseline tests and any claim labelled official.

providers.name: STUDY4
providers.usage: Choose one concrete Listening or Reading test, complete it on STUDY4, then send Joy the platform result and the wrong-question evidence.

providers.name: YouPass
providers.usage: Choose one concrete Listening or Reading test, complete it on YouPass, then send Joy the platform result, answer explanation evidence, and wrong questions.
